rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but the image itself does not clearly show a tightly packed ICM or uniformly cohesive TE; some described details (central ICM, organized peripheral TE, slight upper-pole thinning) are somewhat inferred rather than clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a reasonable prognosis estimate tied to age and morphology, though some numeric modifiers appear somewhat arbitrary and a few claims are stronger than the evidence supports.

Mostly aligned on SET, age-related aneuploidy counseling, and general transfer management, but recommendations such as routine DFI testing, ERA after a first failure, thrombophilia/immunologic workup, and acupuncture/assisted hatching suggestions are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care and could be better prioritized.
